text: DRUG INTERACTIONS PLASMA LEVELS OF ANTICONVULSANT AGENTS MAY BECOME SUBTHERAPEUTIC DURING CISPLATIN THERAPY. IN A RANDOMIZED TRIAL IN ADVANCED OVARIAN CANCER, RESPONSE DURATION WAS ADVERSELY AFFECTED WHEN PYRIDOXINE WAS USED IN COMBINATION WITH ALTRETAMINE (HEXAMETHYLMELAMINE) AND CISPLATIN. CONTRAINDICATIONS CISPLATIN IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WITH PRE-EXISTING RENAL IMPAIRMENT. CISPLATIN SHOULD NOT BE EMPLOYED IN MYELOSUPPRESSED PATIENTS, OR IN PATIENTS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT. CISPLATIN IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WITH A HISTORY OF ALLERGIC REACTIONS TO CISPLATIN OR OTHER PLATINUM CONTAINING COMPOUNDS.
